title: Chiropractic for Kids With Sensory Processing Challenges
official: The Effects of Chiropractic on Kids With Sensory Processing Challenges: a Pilot Observational Study
summary: The main aim of this pilot observational study is to investigate the feasibility of implementing our novel assessment battery in tandem with normal and customary chiropractic care in a practice-based setting using a pediatric population with parent-reported sensory processing disorder (SPD). The secondary aim is to assess potential changes in objective and subjective outcomes.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* 5-12 years of age.
* SSP total scores ≤154

Exclusion Criteria:

* A known heart condition, including pacemakers
* Chiropractic care within the past 30 days
